fnol_text: My name is Olusegun Wojcik and I live at 532 Kestrel Court, Springfield, OH 45575. You can reach me on (555) 473-6762 or olusegun.wojcik@example.com. On 31 August 2026 another car pulled out of a side road and hit my front passenger side. The other driver, Imogen Delgado, admitted they didn't see me. Policy MT-2025-00106. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car. Am I insured for this or not?

adjuster_notes.text: Called Ms Wojcik on (555) 473-6762 to acknowledge the claim. Olusegun confirmed the loss date as 31 August 2026.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Rafael Santos gave a statement by phone.
Third-party driver Imogen Delgado reports whiplash and attended St. Brendan's Hospital. Olusegun reports lacerations to the forearm.
